fact: Madagascar's forecasting office (WFO) presents a PUMA 2015 station (recently upgraded) and says it uses MSG-3 IODC satellite imagery to detect and analyse deep convection in tropical cyclone monitoring.
The African Union Commission's ClimSA deck lists Madagascar among 41 of 49 member states with a PUMA station installed as at 12 May 2026; the station carries satellite imagery.
